scratchBoxes.instruction: Scratch this box only if 67 has not been opened.

states.revealedCondition: First box scratched because 67 was still sealed. Second box still covered.
states.revealedText: It's critical that we Recon South America soon–before the Hollow Men sabotage anything important.

states.revealedCondition: Both boxes scratched. The second box was not part of the instruction.
states.revealedText:
It's critical that we Recon South America soon–before the Hollow Men sabotage anything important.

We didn't tell you to scratch this box.

mechanics.whenRead: STOP. Draw and read during step 2 of the setup of the first game in March. Legacy-deck reading stops on this card.
triggers: 67 has not been opened: scratch only the first box.
rules: If 67 is already open, scratch nothing.
If 67 is sealed, scratch the first box only. The revealed text tells the group to Recon South America. It does not itself open a package or complete an objective.
The second box is a decoy. Scratching it reveals only: We didn't tell you to scratch this box.
Destroy this card after resolving it.
mechanics.notes: "Recon South America" is bold in the first box. The dash in "soon–before" is an en dash. Side A is unchanged in state 2 and state 3.
